description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kanewala, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530179
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land parcel numbers, owners, addresses, identity card numbers, extent of land, nature of ownership, and encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land property matters, specifically title registration and settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
